description: Hand-reasoned mapping from internal refusal codes to the response an agent or host receives (D-018 A7, D-019, D-020). Command external-refusal: input {"internal_code": CODE}, output {"external": CODE}. Internal codes remain in audit records and test harnesses. PENDING INDEPENDENT REVIEW. One generic code, PROMOTION_REFUSED, is used for every non-validation security refusal, including effect and broker refusals.
